messages:
lucas_sales: ArborAI ready to kick off a 3-week POC. they're interested in zephyr-34b-kvquant for multi-doc QA + semantic search + embeddings. can SEs confirm catalog availability and private deploy options?

sara_se: Quick check: zephyr-34b-kvquant is onboarded to catalog v2 but only on our dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and us-central-1. Not yet validated for Private (customer-managed VPC) images.

sara_se: Behavior notes: quant variant reduces memory by ~45% but may increase token-level hallucination for rare token sequences. recommend running a regression on their top-50 queries.

lee_infra: Private deploy path: supported, but we'll need to build and sign a special runtime image for the quant kernels. Ops effort ~3 business days for ECR layout + VPC peering rules. Will open INF-5002.

priya_security: On the security side: ArborAI requested data residency and a copy of our pen test report + network diagram. We can provide SOC2 Type 2 + pen test summary; full network diagram redacted. If they require contractual DPA changes, legal needs to review.

noah_product: For POC success criteria, suggest: 1) avg F1 > baseline by <=1.5% drop vs full-precision on the 100-sample eval, 2) embedding cosine recall >=0.92 on their retrieval set, 3) p95 latency <400ms for 1024-token ops. I'll draft runbook.

arborai_prod: @lucas_sales thanks — two asks from our side: 1) can you include a fallback option to zephyr-34b-fp32 if quality drops? 2) we need an estimate for a 3-week dedicated pool at ~60 reqs/s with burst to 150.

sara_se: Fallback is possible; we'll prepare a canary route: primary zephyr-34b-kvquant, fallback to zephyr-34b-fp32 in same pool class. Need to confirm capacity cost delta.

lee_infra: Cost ballpark: dedicated mini-pool sized for 60 rps (avg 512 tokens) with burst headroom -> estimated $28k-$34k for 3 weeks. Exact calc after we size KV cache and autoscale triggers. INF-5002 will have sizing.

priya_security: Also note: they asked about KMS with customer-managed keys. We support envelope encryption; HSM attestation is only available via partner offer and adds ~2-3 weeks. Ask them if cloud KMS is acceptable for the trial.

lucas_sales: I'll push them to accept cloud KMS for the POC. Noah — include quant caveat in runbook and the metric thresholds you mentioned.

noah_product: On it. I'll include a short monitoring dashboard (token-level cost, p50/p95 latency, error rate) and a rollback playbook: auto-switch to fp32 if eval drop >2.5% or error rate >1.5%.

sara_se: For the eval harness: request 100 labeled QA pairs + 100 retrieval queries. We will run both throughput and quality checks. Please deliver in CSV.

arborai_prod: We'll provide CSV tomorrow morning. Also can you confirm tokenization? we use a custom pre-tokenizer pipeline.

sara_se: Good question — zephyr family uses byte-level bpe. If custom pipeline changes token alignment, we should run tokenizer diff. Bring a sample script or we'll provide one.

lee_infra: INF-5002 created, linked here. Action owner: lee_infra. ETA 3 days for private image + pool provisioning.

priya_security: I'll attach SOC2 docs and our redacted pen test summary into the PR. If ArborAI needs more, escalate to GRC.

lucas_sales: Action items: 1) ArborAI: send CSV eval + token samples. 2) Sara: run regression + tokenizer diff. 3) Lee: INF-5002 infra + cost calc. 4) Priya: drop SOC2 + pen test summary. 5) Noah: POC runbook + monitoring/rollback. I'll assemble the package and send proposal tonight.

arborai_prod: Thanks all — we'll upload artifacts by 09:00 PT tomorrow. Please include invoice estimate in the POC package.

(automated) infra-bot: INF-5002 created and assigned to lee_infra
